image_description: A modern outdoor staircase featuring a sleek, metallic bannister system. The structure includes a continuous tubular handrail running parallel to the incline, supported by thin vertical metal balusters. A prominent newel post anchors the bottom corner of the railing. The background shows a concrete retaining wall and grassy terrain.

Connection points between balusters and handrail/base
Perspective consistency of the railing relative to the stairs
